name: dsh-stl-viewer
description: STL / STEP preview in the DSH side card: a hand-rolled WebGL viewer with 360° free tumbling (left-drag rotate past the poles, wheel zoom, right-drag pan) that reads STL directly and tessellates STEP, IGES and BREP through OpenCascade in a host worker, with Bambu-style measuring that snaps to vertices, edges, faces and circles, an assembly mode that explodes the parts and spins any one of them, Chinese / English labels, a corner panel that reads out diameters, an XYZ triad labelled with the model axes, and volume / surface / view presets / wireframe / PNG export. Meshing gears are paired by geometry and driven as one train, any part can be turned by hand with the mouse, and the motion panel folds down to its title when it covers the model, and a big assembly gets a timeout that grows with the file.
author: H-h-Hh

scripts.check: node --check lib/client.js && node test/smoke.cjs && node test/host.mjs
